verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs say dashboards can be shared across the business and saved for the team to revisit, and they claim team/user permissions and fine-grained access controls. However, nothing ties those permissions specifically to dashboard or report sharing, and nothing shows a way to share with external board members. missing for 10: documented per-dashboard/report scoped sharing, board/external viewer access, details on permission granularity for shared reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share dashboards and reports with the board or team under scoped access

citations.quote: Aggregate, spotlight, and share key metrics, trends, and answers across your business
save it as a dashboard or report your team can revisit and update later
Team and user permissions provide complete control over who can access sensitive data.
enterprise-grade security featuring access controls, fine-grained permissions, audit logs, and more
